description: This file defines classes and methods related to delivery carriers, delivery grids, and delivery grid lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including price calculation logic based on order details and delivery grid configurations.

classes.name: delivery_carrier
classes.description: Represents a delivery carrier with associated delivery grids and price calculation logic.

classes.name: delivery_grid
classes.description: Defines delivery grid configurations used for calculating delivery prices based on order parameters.

classes.name: delivery_grid_line
classes.description: Represents individual lines within a delivery grid, specifying conditions and prices for different delivery scenarios.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the price for a delivery carrier based on the order and context.

methods.name: grid_get
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate delivery grid for a given contact based on country, state, and zip code.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the delivery price based on order totals, weight, and volume within a delivery grid.

methods.name: get_price_from_picking
methods.description: Determines the delivery price from grid lines based on specified conditions and order parameters.
